name: Clear Delivery Optimization Cache
description: Removes cached update and download data from the Windows Delivery Optimization service to free up disk space. This action clears temporary files used for sharing updates but does not disable automatic system updates or Microsoft Store functionality.

description_i18n.en: Removes cached update and download data from the Windows Delivery Optimization service to free up disk space. This action clears temporary files used for sharing updates but does not disable automatic system updates or Microsoft Store functionality.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt zwischengespeicherte Update- und Download-Daten vom Dienst Windows Delivery Optimization, um Speicherplatz freizugeben. Diese Aktion löscht temporäre Dateien zum Teilen von Updates deaktiviert jedoch nicht automatische Systemupdates oder die Funktionalität des Microsoft Stores.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime les données de mise à jour et de téléchargement mises en cache du service d'optimisation de distribution Windows pour libérer de l'espace disque. Cette action supprime les fichiers temporaires utilisés pour partager les mises à jour sans désactiver les mises à jour automatiques ni la fonctionnalité du Microsof

warnings.title: Download Interruption Risk
warnings.message: Active Windows Update or Microsoft Store downloads may be interrupted during the cache clear process. Some update content will need to be downloaded again after cleanup, though this does not affect system stability

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Executes the Delete-DeliveryOptimizationCache cmdlet with Force and IncludePinnedFiles flags to remove existing cache files The service continues operating normally after cleanup, automatically rebuilding necessary data when needed
